  SUBJECT: CIE 1072/CIE_1072 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1072-CHM]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain the three breakthroughs of the keeling curve with a neat sketch.                                 (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"

  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Create"

  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Create"  
  
2C)               List down the functions of the ecosystem.                                                                (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3A)               List and explain the government initiatives taken in both central and state level to protect the water   (5)  
  bodies.

  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4A)               Explain the article provisions made in the constitution which guarantee right to decent and peaceful (5)  
  environment for the citizen of India.

  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"

  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
